name: Adelaida Martínez — a mother named Dolores Bilares
researcher_question: Was Adelaida (Adela) Martínez, wife of Rufino Moreira of Dolores, Soriano, the daughter of Juan Martínez and Dolores Bilares, or of Juan Martínez and Josefa Segovia as the tree records?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 29, hint-samples.csv row 938, flag adds_mother, confidence 3). Resolved as CONFLATION / different answer (Outcome b): the starting tree conflates two women. GRS9-MCH (Adela Natividad, b. 25 Dec 1871, mother Josefa Segovia per ark:/61903/1:1:F2BL-3XN, ark:/61903/1:1:FLSQ-VWB) is distinct from Rufino Moreira's actual 1896 wife, Valentina Adelaida Martines (FamilySearch 9NDQ-JQ7; b. ~15 Dec 1875, mother Dolores Milan per her baptism ark:/61903/1:1:FLSQ-1NP; corroborated by the 9 Apr 1896 church-marriage bride persona ark:/61903/1:1:XS61-CNFW). The hint (ark:/61903/1:1:XS6N-1GXK, the 17 June 1896 civil marriage; indexed '1879' is a collection-start artifact, real date 1896) belongs to Valentina, not GRS9-MCH. expected-findings.json is two required recover findings that reward discovering the conflation. Independent second opinion by Isaac Boateng.
